items.title: Caleb Williams: Spectacular in return from injury
items.text:
Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding four rushes for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Offsets inefficiency with two TDs
items.text:
Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns and brought in four of five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Bijan Robinson: Efficient with limited opportunity
items.text:
Robinson rushed nine times for 61 yards and brought in both targets for minus-8 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 loss to the Bears on Sunday.

items.title: Drake Maye: Three more TD tosses in win
items.text:
Maye completed 18 of 32 passes for 235 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed four times for 24 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: Four catches in Week 6 loss
items.text:
Wilson brought in four of six targets for 44 yards in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
